I or T: B1 [ I or T ] to put a question to someone, or to request an answer from someone

NONE: C2 to consider something carefully
仔細考慮某事

I or T: B1 [ I or T ] to speak or write to someone saying that you want them to do something, to give you something, or to allow you to do something

T: A2 [ T ] to request or invite someone to go somewhere with you or to come to your home
› [ T ] to expect or demand something

example: [ + two objects ] She asked me a question.
她向我問一個問題。
She asked a question about Welsh history.
她問了一個關於威爾士歷史的問題。
She asked me about Welsh history.
她問我有關威爾士歷史的問題。
She asked about Welsh history.
她問了有關威爾士歷史的問題。
[ + question word ] I've no idea what time the train leaves. Ask the guard whether he knows.
我不知道火車甚麼時候開，問問車長是否知道。
I asked the guard the time of the train's departure.
我問了問車長火車的離站時間。
I asked when the train would leave.
我問了問火車甚麼時候開。
[ + speech ] "What time does the train leave?" I asked.
「火車甚麼時候開？」我問道。
She needs to ask herself why nobody seems to like her.
她應當好好想想為什麼好像沒有人喜歡她。
If you need any help, please don't hesitate to ask.
如果有需要幫忙的地方，請儘管說。
She asked (her manager) if/whether she could leave early to pick up the kids.
她問（經理）自己是否可以提早離開去接孩子。
I asked to see my accountant.
我要求見我的會計師。
You should ask (your accountant) for some financial advice.
你應該（向你的會計師）徵求財務方面的建議。
[ + to infinitive ] You should ask your accountant to give you some financial advice.
你應該向你的會計師查詢一些財務方面的建議。
Can I ask you a favour?/formal Can I ask a favour of you?
你可以幫我一個忙嗎？
I'd like to ask your advice/opinion on a financial matter.
我遇到一個財務方面的問題，想聽聽你的建議／意見。
You have to ask permission to leave.
你必須徵得許可方能離開。
formal We ask that any faulty goods be returned in their original packaging.
我們要求凡有質量問題的貨物都裝回原包裝內退回。
[ + that ] formal The solicitor asked that her client be allowed to make a phone call.
律師要求允許她的當事人打個電話。
UK I've asked David to the party.
我已經邀請了大衛來參加派對。
[ + to infinitive ] US I've asked David to come to the party.
我已經邀請了大衛來參加派對。
"Are you going to Muriel's party?" "No, I haven't been asked."
「你會參加繆裡爾的派對嗎？」「不，我沒有接到邀請。」
Jorge has asked us over for dinner next Friday.
豪爾赫邀請我們下星期五共進晚餐。
UK Ian's asked us round to/for dinner next Friday.
伊恩請我們下週五去吃晚飯。
In fact they've asked us to stay for the whole weekend.
實際上他們請我們過去逗留一整個週末。

Greg's asking (= expecting to be paid) £250,000 for his house.
葛列格的房子要價25萬英鎊。
He asks too much of me - I can't always be there to help him.
他對我的要求太過分了——我不能總在那裡幫他吧。

如果你的老闆要求你晚上加班，週末也工作，那就太過分了。

NONE: › to ask for information about someone, especially about their health
探問；（尤指）問起（某人）的健康情況，問候

example: Tell your father I was asking after him.
代我向你父親問好。

NONE: › to ask a lot of different people in order to get information or help
四處打聽；多方詢問

example: Our babysitter's just moved away, so we're asking around for a replacement.
我們的臨時保姆剛剛搬走，我們正在到處打聽想另找一個。

NONE: › to say that you would like to see or speak to someone
找（某人）

example: A young man was here asking for you this morning.
今天上午有個年輕人到這裡找你。

NONE: › If you say you couldn't ask for someone or something better, you mean that that person or thing is the best of their type.
找得到（更好的）

example: She's great to work for - I really couldn't ask for a better boss.
為她工作是件樂事——我真覺得再也找不到比她更好的老闆了。

NONE: › to invite someone to come into a building or room, especially your home
請（某人）進來；（尤指）把（某人）請進家

example: I'd ask you in for a coffee but I have to get up early for work in the morning.
我很想請你上家裡喝杯咖啡，但是我明天要早起工作。

NONE: › to invite someone to come with you to a place such as the cinema or a restaurant, especially as a way of starting a romantic relationship
（尤指為了開始與某人建立戀愛關係）請…外出（或吃飯、看電影等）

example: She's asked Steve out to the cinema this evening.
她請了史蒂芬今晚出去看電影。
You should ask her out sometime.
你甚麼時候應該約她出來。

NONE: › to look at or think about someone or something with doubt, disapproval, or no trust
（不滿或懷疑地）斜眼看，瞟

example: They looked askance at our scruffy clothes.
他們滿腹疑惑地看著我們破破爛爛的衣服。

NONE: › not straight or level
不正（的），歪斜（的）

example: Isn't that picture slightly askew?
那幅畫是不是有點掛歪了？
My hat was askew so I adjusted it in the mirror.
我的帽子戴歪了，於是我對著鏡子把帽子弄正。

NONE: › the amount of money someone wants when they sell something, especially a building or a piece of land
（尤指建築物或地皮的）索價，要價
